title: [29.x][ALL-E]Issues with Service Contract Invoicing and Retrospective Billing--when the second unposted Service Invoice is deleted the values on the Service Contract are no longer reset--The "Invoiced to Date" field does not resetInitial commit- #10345Initial commit
summary: Fixed Service Contract invoicing to properly reset the "Invoiced to Date" field when unposted Service Invoices are deleted, even when multiple invoices have been processed.
key_points: The "Invoiced to Date" field was stuck at its previous value after deleting the second unposted invoice, blocking new invoices from being created
Reversed ledger entries left behind by deleted invoices were incorrectly counted as existing entries
The fix filters out reversed entries by checking for original entries without corresponding reversals
Contract lines with only reversed invoicing history now correctly reset "Invoiced to Date" to zero
quote: when the second unposted Service Invoice is deleted the values on the Service Contract are no longer reset
